counts.counting_note: Eight required scientific input families are surface elevation, crust thickness, mantle-lithosphere thickness, thermal/heat-flow structure, density/reference materials, rheology, FE mesh support and BC/fault interface. One family is fully available as a governed R6 planetary baseline (radius/gravity, with gMean convention check); one family is partially available (land elevation only). Canonical partition/kinematics is upstream geometry and does not count as a ShellSet physical field. Four independent world-defining primitive families: ocean bathymetry/elevation support; crustal physical-domain/thickness template; ocean lithosphere age/ridge-history primitive; continental thermal/structural initialization. Specialist configuration families are reference material/density, thermal coefficients and rheology. Adapter-only gaps are mesh projection/identity and pyGPlates-to-.bcs conversion; they remain blocked by open node/frame semantics. Six true blocker groups are listed in remaining_blockers. Counts are families, not scalar parameters or per-cell arrays.

remaining_blockers.reason: R6 has only a land elevation field and explicitly unknown numeric bathymetry; ShellSet needs an elevation value at its modeled nodes.
No physical thickness field; current OrbData Assign reads a grid. Need compact authorial domain/template and constrained ranges.
No age, ridge history, heat-flow or geotherm state. Age is not inferable from plate ID; GWB needs configured inputs.
rhoBar/rhoAst, density-water terms, alphaT, conductivity, heat production and geotherm constraints are unbound; only gMean/radius are present in the R6 design baseline.
SHELLS law family is known but no physical parameter ranges/ensemble/config selected; exact pinned release parameter inventory must be captured.
No FEG mesh, node correspondence, authorized .bcs frame/node policy, fault element policy or junction transfer contract.

next_stage: Constrain the four independent world-defining primitive schemas and three specialist configuration families as governed ranges/ensembles, while specifying mesh/.bcs interface invariants. The minimum field-production routes are known (OrbData5 plus a configured GWB/thermal path); no new scientific specialist or custom ARCANA physics is needed. Runtime qualification remains a later separately authorized stage.
